findings.problem: This establishes the canonical simplification from the existential natural-index predicate `D.heavyFlag n.val` to the subtype-indexed predicate `D.heavy n`, but it is not tagged `[simp]`. The target's `heavy_mover` proof consequently has to invoke `heavyFlag_at` explicitly when rewriting the imported payment bound.
findings.proposed_change: Tag `heavyFlag_at` with `[simp]`, so `simp` and `simp only [heavyFlag_at]` can normalize `D.heavyFlag n.val` to `D.heavy n` in such bounds.
findings.benefit: This makes the subtype-indexed predicate the normal form and avoids manual rewrites at uses such as `heavy_mover`, while preserving the equivalence for every `n : Fin N`.
